title: sagenia vitis
intro: Sagenia vitis, commonly known as the fern-like plant, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an antiseptic, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sagenia vitis include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
